_about: Mock Læsning 3: short hand-written sentences, one gap each. opts = the 3 wrong options. Rule: the 4 options never share both kind of logic and word type (ADV = V2, SUB = bisætning, KOO = hovedsætning, PRAEP = + navneord), so only one fits the gap's grammar and meaning.
